title: 黄金能源撑起CPI：核心通胀原地踏步，涨价为何不全面
speaker: Xiao Jiajue

segments.en: I think there's come broadly in line with market expectations as well as ours.
segments.zh: 我认为数据基本符合市场和我们的预期。

segments.en: I think it's rebounding in August from July.
I think if we look at the CPI, of course, we need to read more detail numbers.
segments.zh: 看CPI的话，我们需要看更详细的数据。

segments.en: I think the 0.3% increase in August is likely mostly driven by energy prices increases as well as gold prices increases in August compared to July.
segments.zh: 8月环比上涨0.3%，可能主要受能源和黄金价格上涨推动。

segments.en: So if we look at the core, I think it's roughly slightly up by 0.1%, I think that could be mostly reflecting on higher gold prices as well as likely the continued price hikes for those smartphones, for example, kind of tag-related material price increases.
segments.zh: 核心通胀环比微升0.1%，可能反映金价上涨以及智能手机等商品价格上调。

segments.en: So I think outside of the materials, commodities, energy and materials and the intermediate inputs and the equipment related to AI, I suspect that the reflationary forces in China are still rather weak.
segments.zh: 除能源、大宗商品、中间品和AI相关设备外，中国的再通胀动力仍然偏弱。
